title: AI Merit Scholarship
description: Awarded to students with a strong academic record and a demonstrated AI-related project or research interest.

title: Women in Computing Scholarship
description: Supports women pursuing computing degrees with an interest in AI or systems research.

title: Student Entrepreneur Seed Grant
provider: NUS Technology Venture Studio (Prof. Jonathan Teo)
description: Small non-dilutive grant for student teams building an early-stage product prototype.

title: Undergraduate Research Track Stipend
description: Stipend for undergraduates doing a sustained RA commitment (2+ semesters) with a faculty lab.

title: Regional Language Technology Fellowship
provider: NUS Multilingual AI Lab (Prof. Meera Pillai)
description: Supports students working on NLP for under-resourced Southeast Asian languages.

title: Faculty General Merit Award
description: Broad merit-based award, not tied to a specific research area.
